exposure: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) with fetal blood flow redistribution
cohort: The study included 20 FGR neonates (mean gestational age 31.4 weeks, mean birth weight 1,205 g) and 20 gestation-matched appropriately grown (AGA) neonates (mean gestational age 31.1 weeks, mean birth weight 1,668 g).
finding: Corpus callosum and cerebellar measurements were significantly smaller in FGR neonates with fetal blood flow redistribution compared to AGA neonates, independent of birth weight.
birth_weight: FGR neonates: 1,205 ± 463 g; AGA neonates: 1,668 ± 490 g
gest_age: FGR neonates: 31.4 ± 3.1 weeks; AGA neonates: 31.1 ± 3.0 weeks
